# AACSB

> AACSB is the global accrediting body and network for business education, connecting accredited schools, educators, students, and employers to advance business education standards and leadership development worldwide.

AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business) serves as the premier accreditation organization for business schools globally, offering accreditation standards, member networking platforms, data analytics, and career resources. The organization bridges educators, learners, and businesses through its comprehensive suite of tools and community initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Business Accreditation
- AACSB Accreditation Standards

## Accreditation Standards & Services

- [Business Accreditation](https://www.aacsb.edu/educators/accreditation/business-accreditation): AACSB business accreditation standards and process overview
- [The Value of Accreditation](https://www.aacsb.edu/educators/accreditation/value-of-accreditation): Overview of AACSB accreditation value and benefits
- [Search Accredited Schools](https://www.aacsb.edu/accredited): Directory of AACSB-accredited business schools worldwide
- [AI Use Cases for Accreditation](https://www.aacsb.edu/educators/accreditation/business-accreditation/ai-use-cases-for-accreditation): AI use cases and AccredAI assistant for accreditation compliance
- [2025 State of Accreditation Report](https://www.aacsb.edu/insights/reports/2025/2025-state-of-accreditation-report): 2025 accreditation outcomes and insights report

## Member Platforms & Tools

- [myAccreditation Portal](https://www.aacsb.edu/tools/myaccreditation): myAccreditation portal for managing accreditation materials
- [AACSB Exchange](https://www.aacsb.edu/tools/exchange): AACSB Exchange: member networking and resource sharing platform
- [Analytics Hub](https://www.aacsb.edu/tools/analytics-hub): Analytics Hub: member-exclusive data visualization and benchmarking
- [DataDirect](https://www.aacsb.edu/tools/datadirect): DataDirect: global business education data and survey platform
- [MyAACSB Member Portal](https://my.aacsb.edu/My-Account/Pay-My-Invoices): MyAACSB member portal login and account access

## Membership & Community

- [Educator Membership](https://www.aacsb.edu/educators/membership): Educator membership benefits and Business Education Alliance
- [Business Membership](https://www.aacsb.edu/businesses/business-membership): Business membership in AACSB's Business Education Alliance
- [Member Directory & Solutions Library](https://www.aacsb.edu/resources): Member directory and solutions library with case studies

## Careers & Student Resources

- [Career Connection](https://www.aacsb.edu/tools/career-connection): Career Connection job board for business education careers
- [Students](https://www.aacsb.edu/learners): Student resources and guidance to AACSB-accredited schools

## Stakeholder Hubs

- [Businesses Leading Boldly](https://www.aacsb.edu/businesses): AACSB business recruitment and employer partnership hub
- [Global Business Education Network](https://www.aacsb.edu): AACSB homepage: transforming business education globally

## Events & Networking

- [Events App](https://www.aacsb.edu/events/events-app): AACSB Events App for conference management and networking
